steps.name: Install production Python 3.14, runtime deps and pinned test tools
argv: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3-venv && python3 -m venv /tmp/uv-bootstrap && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/pip install --quiet uv==0.10.2 && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv venv --python 3.14.3 .venv && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv pip install --python .venv -r requirements.txt pytest==9.1.1 ruff==0.15.21

steps.name: Build the wheel once and record its digest
Smoke-test the built wheel from a clean venv, then boot the source server (Dockerfile parity)
argv: (cd .ci-results/dist && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); accept=$(mktemp -d); /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv venv --python 3.14.3 "$accept"; /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv pip install --python "$accept" .ci-results/dist/*.whl; (cd "$accept" && ./bin/elixis --version && ./bin/elixis --help > /dev/null && ./bin/python -I -c 'from elixis import knowledge as k; assert k.archetypes() and k.characters(), "wheel is missing knowledge data"' && ./bin/elixis patterns --text 'A quiet glassblower restores old lighthouse lenses.' > /dev/null); log=.ci-results/server.log; .venv/bin/python app.py --port 3110 > "$log" 2>&1 & pid=$!; trap 'kill $pid 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3110/ && break; sleep 1; done; kill -0 "$pid" || { echo 'server exited early'; cat "$log"; exit 1; }; for path in / /llms.txt /api/health; do code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/body -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:3110$path || true); echo "$path $code"; test "$code" = 200 || { cat "$log"; exit 1; }; done; python3 -c 'import json; b=json.load(open("/tmp/body")); assert "status" in b, b; print("health:", b["status"])'
